The '''Mod VI cyberarm''' or '''Cyberarm Mod VI''' was a model of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Limb/Legends|arm]] made by the leading manufacturer in cybernetic body parts, [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]], and sold for 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The arm primarily acted as a replacement for lost limbs, but also provided increased dexterity to the user. Amputees were the target audience for the product; which was compatible with hundreds of different [[Species/Legends|species]], but due to the dexterity boost it was not uncommon for others to replace their perfectly healthy limbs with Model VIs. The model was available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cyberarm Model VI was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]] and written by [[Sterling Hershey]].
